commits.author: prafsoni
commits.message:
Add OAuth2 support in spring-config-client (#3129)

* feat: Add initial implementation for oauth2 support in the spring cloud config client

Signed-off-by: prafsoni <prafsoni@gmail.com>

* test: Add integration tests for config client oauth2 support

Signed-off-by: prafsoni <prafsoni@gmail.com>

* test: Add integration tests for config client oauth2 support using issuer uri

Signed-off-by: prafsoni <prafsoni@gmail.com>

* docs: Update client docs to add an example for oauth2 client config

Signed-off-by: prafsoni <prafsoni@gmail.com>

* test: fix pom version after rebase

Signed-off-by: prafsoni <prafsoni@gmail.com>

* chore: fix pom version after rebase

Signed-off-by: prafsoni <prafsoni@gmail.com>

* refactor: Make config-client OAuth2 support pluggable and optional

Move OAuth2 wiring into a new oauth2 sub-package gated by ClassUtils.isPresent
so spring-boot-starter-security-oauth2-client is genuinely optional. Replace the
duplicate spring.cloud.config.oauth2 registration/provider schema with a
client-registration-id that points at a standard Spring Security registration
under spring.security.oauth2.client.*.

ConfigClientRequestTemplateFactory no longer references Spring Security; it just
accepts additional interceptors. The interceptor is wired for both the Config
Data flow (ConfigClientOAuth2Support.registerInterceptor via the bootstrap
context, with the bind handler threaded so encrypted/placeholder secrets
resolve) and the legacy bootstrap flow (ConfigClientOAuth2BootstrapConfiguration
beans). Every collaborator (ClientRegistrationRepository,
OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager, ClientRegistrationIdResolver, and the interceptor
itself) is overridable, and the default repository is built lazily so a
user-supplied manager makes it unnecessary.

Signed-off-by: prafsoni <prafsoni@gmail.com>
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore: address PR comments

* chore: address PR comment regarding refresh token grant type

commits.author: Mahammad Eminov
commits.message:
Migrate Config Client to Spring Framework native retry (#3303)

* Migrate Config Client to Spring Framework retry

Fixes gh-3261

Signed-off-by: Mahammad Eminov <mahammad.eminov.a@gmail.com>

* Address retry migration review feedback

- Keep class-based proxies for the retry targets via
  @Proxyable(ProxyType.TARGET_CLASS), as @EnableRetry(proxyTargetClass = true)
  did, without forcing class-based proxies application wide.
- Support the enabled parameter on configserver: import URLs so retry can
  be turned off for profile-specific imports.
- Regenerate _configprops.adoc for spring.cloud.config.retry.enabled.

See gh-3261

Signed-off-by: Mahammad Eminov <mahammad.eminov.a@gmail.com>

* Preserve legacy bootstrap retry compatibility

Keep legacy backoff handling lenient, allow the retry advisor to be overridden, and document the single-attempt opt-out.

See gh-3261

Signed-off-by: Mahammad Eminov <mahammad.eminov.a@gmail.com>

* Preserve opt-in Config Client retry behavior

Keep native retry opt-in, link to the Spring Framework retry documentation, and remove the unsupported config import URL parameter.

See gh-3261

Signed-off-by: Mahammad Eminov <mahammad.eminov.a@gmail.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Mahammad Eminov <mahammad.eminov.a@gmail.com>
